title: More Ancient Debris
description: This server-side mod adds more ancient debris to the nether so you can spend less time grinding and more time enjoying !
body:
This server-side mod **adds more ancient debris to the nether**.
It works by creating a block named "More Ancient Debris" to minecraft and makes it generate in the nether.

Once mined **this block acts just like ancient debris** having the same statistics and being smeltable to make **netherite scrap**.

This mod is made for people that are tired of grinding and that just want to have fun !
